I-b / OCR & Speaker Notes Processing

Image text extraction · Speaker notes as faculty intent — both valuable, both distinct

Why OCR matters for medical education specifically

Medical lecture slides are saturated with image-embedded text. Pathway diagrams (glycolysis, coagulation cascade, RAAS), anatomy figures with structural labels, histology images with annotations, drug mechanism schematics, ECG tracings with marked intervals, lab panels as screenshots — all common, all invisible to text parsers. A pharmacology lecture on beta-blockers may have 60% of its mechanistic content in images. Without OCR, the SubConcept extraction step sees an artificially thin content chunk and misses the most clinically rich material on the slide. Speaker notes are the opposite problem: they contain explicit faculty intent ("the key point here is that furosemide blocks NKCC2, NOT NCC") that should inform SubConcept extraction priority but must never appear in student-facing retrieval context.

OCR strategy — two-phase by content type

Phase A — Image-embedded text (Claude Haiku Vision)
Diagrams · Labels · Annotations · Screenshots

Use Claude Haiku Vision for slides where entity_density < 0.1 AND has_image = true — the signal that the slide's text content is primarily in an image. Haiku Vision extracts: (1) all visible text verbatim, (2) labels on anatomical structures/pathways/mechanisms, (3) numerical values in tables, (4) drug names / enzyme names / gene names in pathway schematics. Merged with body_text before chunking. Tagged in the ContentChunk with ocr_source: 'vision'. The merged text becomes the chunk text that gets embedded and extracted.

Phase B — Scanned PDFs (pytesseract fallback)
Detection: <50 chars/page average from pdfplumber

If pdfplumber extracts <50 characters per page on average, the PDF is image-based (scanned). Trigger pytesseract OCR with: deskew preprocessing, adaptive thresholding for medical images, language=eng. Result replaces the empty body_text. Tagged ocr_source: 'tesseract'. Lower confidence than Vision but handles bulk scanned syllabi and older course materials. For syllabi specifically, this is the most common failure mode — faculty submit scanned PDFs from old handouts.

// P1 Step 01b: OCR enrichment — runs AFTER parse-scaffold, BEFORE chunk-embed
// Triggered per section where has_image = true OR body_text is suspiciously thin

async function ocrEnrichSection(
  section: LectureSection,
  slideImageBuffer: Buffer | null
): Promise<string> {
  // Condition 1: slide has an embedded image AND body text is thin
  if (section.has_image && section.body_text.length < 200 && slideImageBuffer) {
    const ocrResult = await anthropic.messages.create({
      model: 'claude-haiku-4-5-20251001',  // Vision-capable + cheap
      max_tokens: 800,
      messages: [{
        role: 'user',
        content: [
          {
            type: 'image',
            source: { type: 'base64', media_type: 'image/png', data: slideImageBuffer.toString('base64') }
          },
          {
            type: 'text',
            text: `This is a medical lecture slide. Extract ALL text content visible in this image:
1. All text labels on anatomical diagrams, pathway schematics, or mechanism figures
2. Drug names, enzyme names, gene names, receptor names in any diagram
3. Numerical values, units, reference ranges in any table or chart
4. Any text in boxes, arrows, callouts, or annotations
5. ECG interval labels, histology stain types, imaging modality markers

Return ONLY the extracted text, organized by location (top to bottom, left to right).
If the image contains no readable text, return exactly: NO_TEXT_FOUND`
          }
        ]
      }]
    });

    const extractedText = ocrResult.content[0].text;
    if (extractedText !== 'NO_TEXT_FOUND') {
      await supabase.from('lecture_sections').update({
        image_alt_text: extractedText,
        body_text: [section.body_text, extractedText].filter(Boolean).join('\n\n[IMAGE CONTENT]\n')
      }).eq('id', section.id);
      return extractedText;
    }
  }

  // Condition 2: scanned PDF — pdfplumber returned almost nothing
  if (section.body_text.length < 50) {
    const { createWorker } = require('tesseract.js');
    const worker = await createWorker('eng');
    const { data: { text } } = await worker.recognize(slideImageBuffer);
    await worker.terminate();

    if (text.trim().length > 20) {
      await supabase.from('lecture_sections').update({
        body_text: text,
        image_alt_text: '[tesseract-ocr]'
      }).eq('id', section.id);
      return text;
    }
  }

  return section.body_text;  // no OCR needed
}

// Slide image extraction from PPTX (for Vision API)
// python-pptx renders each slide to a PNG using slide.shapes
async function extractSlideImage(pptxBuffer: Buffer, slideIndex: number): Promise<Buffer | null> {
  // Call Python microservice: POST /render-slide {pptx_base64, slide_index}
  const res = await fetch(`${process.env.PPTX_RENDERER_URL}/render-slide`, {
    method: 'POST',
    body: JSON.stringify({ pptx_base64: pptxBuffer.toString('base64'), slide_index: slideIndex })
  });
  const { image_base64, has_image } = await res.json();
  return has_image ? Buffer.from(image_base64, 'base64') : null;
}

// For syllabi PDFs — scanned detection + OCR fallback
// Added to syllabus parsing pipeline (separate from lecture P1)
async function parseOrOcrSyllabus(pdfBuffer: Buffer): Promise<string> {
  const pdfplumberText = await extractPdfText(pdfBuffer);  // Python pdfplumber service
  const avgCharsPerPage = pdfplumberText.length / (pdfBuffer.length / 50000); // rough page estimate

  if (avgCharsPerPage < 50) {
    // Scanned PDF — use Claude Haiku Vision page by page
    const pageImages = await renderPdfPages(pdfBuffer);  // pdf2image service
    const ocrPages = await Promise.all(pageImages.map(img =>
      anthropic.messages.create({
        model: 'claude-haiku-4-5-20251001',
        max_tokens: 1000,
        messages: [{ role: 'user', content: [
          { type: 'image', source: { type: 'base64', media_type: 'image/jpeg', data: img } },
          { type: 'text', text: 'Extract all text from this medical school syllabus page. Preserve structure. Return extracted text only.' }
        ]}]
      }).then(r => r.content[0].text)
    ));
    return ocrPages.join('\n\n---PAGE BREAK---\n\n');
  }
  return pdfplumberText;
}

Speaker notes — faculty intent, not student content

Speaker notes occupy a unique epistemic position in the pipeline. They are written by faculty for faculty — explicit teaching intent, clinical pearls, emphasis markers ("this is high-yield for Step 1"), caveats ("tell them NOT to confuse this with..."). They are the closest thing to faculty voice the system has access to. But they must be handled entirely separately from body text: never mixed into ContentChunks that students retrieve, never embedded into the same index, but actively used to improve SubConcept extraction quality and to seed SyllabusTopic intent signals.

// Speaker notes processing — parallel track to body_text chunks
// THREE distinct uses, none of which mix notes into student retrieval

async function processSpeakerNotes(section: LectureSection) {
  if (!section.speaker_notes || section.speaker_notes.trim().length < 10) return;

  // USE 1: SubConcept extraction priority boost
  // Speaker notes often name the target concept explicitly
  // Extract concept hints to boost NER confidence during P1 Step 03
  const hintResult = await anthropic.messages.create({
    model: 'claude-haiku-4-5-20251001',
    max_tokens: 150,
    messages: [{
      role: 'user',
      content: `Analyze these speaker notes from a medical lecture slide:

"${section.speaker_notes}"

Extract:
1. The PRIMARY medical concept this slide is teaching (one phrase)
2. Any "high yield" or "Step 1" signals (yes/no)
3. Any explicit misconceptions the faculty warns against

Return JSON: {"primary_concept": "...", "high_yield": boolean, "warned_misconceptions": ["..."]}`
    }]
  });

  const hints = JSON.parse(hintResult.content[0].text);

  // Store as SpeakerNote node in Neo4j — NOT linked to ContentChunk embedding index
  // LINKED to LectureSection only — informational, not retrievable by students
  await neo4j.run(`
    MATCH (ls:LectureSection {uuid: $sectionId})
    MERGE (sn:SpeakerNote {uuid: $noteUuid})
      ON CREATE SET
        sn.raw_text = $rawText,
        sn.primary_concept_hint = $primaryConcept,
        sn.high_yield_signal = $highYield,
        sn.warned_misconceptions = $misconceptions,
        sn.epistemic_status = 'faculty_intent',  // never student-facing
        sn.created_at = datetime()
    MERGE (ls)-[:HAS_SPEAKER_NOTE]->(sn)
  `, {
    sectionId: section.id,
    noteUuid: deterministicUuid(`note:${section.id}`),
    rawText: section.speaker_notes,
    primaryConcept: hints.primary_concept,
    highYield: hints.high_yield,
    misconceptions: hints.warned_misconceptions
  });

  // USE 2: SubConcept confidence boosting
  // If the speaker note names a UMLS concept explicitly → boost the TEACHES edge
  // from the section's ContentChunks to that SubConcept from 'C' to 'B'
  if (hints.primary_concept && hints.primary_concept.length > 3) {
    await neo4j.run(`
      MATCH (ls:LectureSection {uuid: $sectionId})-[:HAS_CHUNK]->(cc:ContentChunk)
            -[t:TEACHES]->(sc:SubConcept)
      WHERE toLower(sc.name) CONTAINS toLower($hint)
         OR sc.name =~ '(?i).*' + $hint + '.*'
      SET t.evidence_grade = 'B',
          t.evidence_weight = 0.82,
          t.boosted_by = 'speaker_note_hint'
    `, { sectionId: section.id, hint: hints.primary_concept });
  }

  // USE 3: MisconceptionCategory seeding from explicit faculty warnings
  // "Don't confuse furosemide with spironolactone" → creates WARNED_AGAINST relationship
  for (const misconception of hints.warned_misconceptions) {
    await neo4j.run(`
      MATCH (sn:SpeakerNote {uuid: $noteUuid})
      MERGE (w:FacultyWarning {text: $misconception, lecture_section_uuid: $sectionId})
      MERGE (sn)-[:WARNS_AGAINST]->(w)
    `, { noteUuid: deterministicUuid(`note:${section.id}`), misconception, sectionId: section.id });
    // FacultyWarning nodes: reviewed by admin quarterly to update MisconceptionCategory seed
  }
}
What speaker notes are never used for

Speaker notes are NOT embedded into pgvector. They are NOT included in content_chunks. They are NOT part of any student-facing retrieval context. They do NOT appear in the LOD brief. The wall is architectural: SpeakerNote nodes have epistemic_status: 'faculty_intent' and no embedding columns. The retrieval layer has a hard exclusion: ContentChunks are only created from body_text, never from speaker_notes. This is the same separation as TEACHES vs COVERS_TOPIC — declared intent vs verified delivery.

OCR_ENABLED=true                         # Feature flag — disable during dev if slow
pptx-renderer sidecar
python-pptx → PNG

Python Flask service. Accepts PPTX file + slide_index, returns PNG render of that slide. Detects has_image by checking shape.shape_type == MSO_SHAPE_TYPE.PICTURE. Runs on Railway / Fly.io with python-pptx + Pillow. 2 replicas for concurrency.

pdf-renderer sidecar
pdf2image → JPEG

Python Flask service. Uses pdf2image (poppler wrapper) to render PDF pages as JPEG images. Returns all pages as base64 JPEG array. Only invoked when pdfplumber detects a scanned PDF (<50 chars/page average). DPI=200 sufficient for text extraction.

Cost impact of OCR
~$0.001/slide for Vision OCR

Claude Haiku Vision: ~800 input tokens (image) + 200 output tokens ≈ $0.0003/slide. For a 50-slide lecture where 20 slides have images: ~$0.006 additional per lecture. Amortized: negligible vs the SubConcept quality improvement from capturing pathway diagram labels and anatomy figure annotations.

II / Stack & Infrastructure

Every technology decision with rationale

Frontend
Next.js 15
App Router + TypeScript. React Server Components for data-heavy views (coverage heatmap). Client components for interactive (chat, item review). Tailwind CSS. Radix UI primitives. next/image for optimized slides. Deployed on Vercel.
Relational + Vector + Auth
Supabase
PostgreSQL 16 + pgvector 0.7 with HNSW indexes. Row-Level Security on every table (FERPA enforcement). Supabase Auth for faculty/student/admin. Supabase Storage for lecture files. Realtime subscriptions for pipeline status. Edge Functions for lightweight webhooks.
Knowledge Graph
Neo4j Aura
AuraDB Professional (or Enterprise for production). 77 node types, 110 typed edges. APOC for deterministic UUID generation. GDS (Graph Data Science) for PageRank, Louvain, path algorithms. Bolt driver in Next.js API routes. Connection pool: 20 connections max.
Workflow Orchestration
Inngest
14 events. Three pipeline functions. Step-level checkpointing — retry only failed steps. step.waitForEvent() for human approval gates. Concurrency controls per faculty_id. Rate limiting for UMLS API (20 req/sec). Cron schedule for weekly jobs. NOT Kafka (G13: removed from MVP).
LLM (Core)
Claude Sonnet 4
Core item generation (P3 Step 02). Critique gate / AnswerCritic (P3 Step 03). SLO extraction from syllabi. Any task requiring clinical reasoning or multi-step judgment. Model: claude-sonnet-4-20250514. Max tokens: 600 for items, 200 for critique.
LLM (Efficiency)
Claude Haiku 4.5
HyDE vignettes (100 tokens). Distractors (300 tokens). Rationale (400 tokens). QA scoring (150 tokens). LOD brief generation (200 tokens). LCMEDomainClassifier. SAME_AS disambiguation. Lecture summary (150 tokens). Model: claude-haiku-4-5-20251001.
Embeddings (Biomedical)
MedCPT
For ContentChunks where entity_density >0.3 (biomedical content). 768-dim vectors. PubMed-trained — outperforms OpenAI on clinical retrieval. Self-hosted via HuggingFace inference endpoint or Replicate. Separate pgvector HNSW index from general embeddings.
Embeddings (General)
text-embedding-3-small
For pedagogical content (instructions, assessments, course structure). 1536-dim vectors. OpenAI API. Used for: non-biomedical chunks, SLO embeddings, lecture summaries (Level 3), few-shot example retrieval. Cheaper than MedCPT at scale.
UMLS / NER
MetaMap + UMLS API
MetaMap (Java service, self-hosted or Docker) for medical NER in ContentChunks. UMLS API for full Metathesaurus resolution in P2. Batch: 20 entities per UMLS API call. Rate limit: 20 req/sec via Inngest throttle. Aronson & Lang (2010).
File Parsing
python-pptx + pdfplumber
python-pptx for PPTX: slide-by-slide text extraction including speaker notes. pdfplumber for PDF: layout-aware extraction with heading detection. Run in Supabase Edge Function (Python runtime) or dedicated microservice. Max file size: 100MB.
Monitoring
Inngest + Vercel Analytics
Inngest dashboard for pipeline health + step-level failure visibility. Vercel Analytics for frontend performance. Supabase dashboard for DB metrics. Custom: generation_cost_log table tracks per-item cost for budget alerting when cost >$0.20/item.
Future ML (T4+)
HeteroSAGE + Louvain
Neo4j GDS: Louvain community detection for ConceptCluster creation. GraphSAGE (inductive GNN) via Neo4j GDS or PyG for TEACHES link prediction. First retrain at T4 when >100 confirmed SubConcepts with faculty-approved TEACHES edges exist.
What was deliberately excluded and why

Kafka: Removed from MVP (G13 canonical). Inngest handles all workflow events at MSM scale. Kafka is a T5+ concern when >1,000 simultaneous students create throughput that exceeds Inngest per-event economics. Redis: Not needed. Supabase realtime subscriptions handle status push. Inngest handles queue semantics. Add at T4+ if needed for token bucket rate limiting. LangChain / LangGraph: Explicit decision not to use. Each pipeline step is an Inngest step.run() with typed inputs/outputs — deterministic, observable, retryable. No autonomous agent loops in the generation pipeline. Pinecone / Weaviate: pgvector HNSW is sufficient at MSM scale (thousands of chunks, not millions). Migrate to dedicated vector DB at T5+ when collection exceeds 10M vectors.

III / Database Architecture

Supabase schemas · Neo4j constraints · pgvector indexes · UUID bridge

A. Supabase core tables

supabase/migrations/001_core.sqlFERPA RLS on every table
-- All tables include institution_id for RLS scoping
-- RLS policy pattern applied to every user-facing table:
CREATE POLICY institution_isolation ON content_chunks
  USING (institution_id = auth.jwt() ->> 'institution_id');

-- ── FACULTY / ADMIN ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
CREATE TABLE institutions (
  id              UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  name            TEXT NOT NULL,
  slug            TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
  accreditation   TEXT,           -- 'LCME' | 'ACGME' | etc.
  is_showcase     BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE,
  created_at      TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE TABLE faculty_profiles (
  id              UUID PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES auth.users,
  institution_id  UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES institutions,
  role            TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (role IN ('faculty','admin','chair','dean','advisor')),
  courses         UUID[],           -- assigned course UUIDs
  neo4j_uuid      TEXT,             -- bridge to Faculty node (T4)
  created_at      TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- ── CONTENT PIPELINE ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
CREATE TABLE lectures (
  uuid            UUID PRIMARY KEY,
  institution_id  UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES institutions,
  course_id       UUID NOT NULL,
  title           TEXT NOT NULL,
  file_path       TEXT,             -- Supabase Storage path
  file_hash       TEXT UNIQUE,      -- SHA-256 for dedup
  file_type       TEXT CHECK (file_type IN ('pptx','pdf')),
  slide_count     INTEGER,
  status          TEXT DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK (status IN
    ('pending','parsing','chunking','embedding','extracting','enriching','review_pending','complete','failed')),
  -- Dual-write sync status (G08 fix)
  neo4j_synced_at   TIMESTAMPTZ,
  neo4j_sync_status TEXT DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK (neo4j_sync_status IN ('pending','synced','failed')),
  created_at        TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
  updated_at        TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE TABLE content_chunks (
  uuid              UUID PRIMARY KEY,
  institution_id    UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES institutions,
  lecture_uuid      UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES lectures,
  section_uuid      UUID,                -- FK to lecture_sections
  chunk_index       INTEGER NOT NULL,
  text              TEXT NOT NULL,
  text_with_context TEXT NOT NULL,     -- heading context prepended for embedding
  heading_context   TEXT,
  token_count       INTEGER,           -- 150-250 canonical (D04)
  domain_type       TEXT,              -- 'biomedical' | 'pedagogical' for model selection
  discrimination_flag BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE,  -- set by IRT feedback loop
  embedding         vector(768),       -- MedCPT (biomedical) or NULL
  embedding_general vector(1536),     -- text-embedding-3-small (pedagogical) or NULL
  neo4j_synced_at   TIMESTAMPTZ,
  neo4j_sync_status TEXT DEFAULT 'pending'
);

-- HNSW indexes for fast approximate nearest neighbor search
CREATE INDEX chunks_biomedical_hnsw ON content_chunks
  USING hnsw (embedding vector_cosine_ops) WITH (m=16, ef_construction=200);
CREATE INDEX chunks_general_hnsw ON content_chunks
  USING hnsw (embedding_general vector_cosine_ops) WITH (m=16, ef_construction=200);
supabase/migrations/002_lod_assessment.sqlG05 fix: lod_brief in Supabase
-- G05 FIX: lod_brief moved from Neo4j property to Supabase table
-- SubConcept node in Neo4j carries only lod_brief_id UUID FK (<100 bytes)
CREATE TABLE subconcept_lod_briefs (
  id              UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  subconcept_uuid TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,   -- Neo4j SubConcept UUID (bridge)
  institution_id  UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES institutions,
  lod_brief       TEXT NOT NULL,          -- ~200 tokens, Haiku-generated
  generated_at    TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
  model_version   TEXT DEFAULT 'claude-haiku-4-5-20251001'
);

-- G08 FIX: sync status on subconcepts table
CREATE TABLE subconcepts (
  uuid                TEXT PRIMARY KEY,     -- matches Neo4j SubConcept.uuid
  institution_id      UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES institutions,
  name                TEXT NOT NULL,
  cui                 TEXT,                -- UMLS CUI
  status              TEXT DEFAULT 'candidate',
  embedding_source    TEXT DEFAULT 'text_only',
  lod_brief_id        UUID REFERENCES subconcept_lod_briefs,
  neo4j_synced_at     TIMESTAMPTZ,
  neo4j_sync_status   TEXT DEFAULT 'pending'
);

-- Assessment items (full content in Supabase, skinny pointer in Neo4j)
CREATE TABLE assessment_items (
  uuid              UUID PRIMARY KEY,
  institution_id    UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES institutions,
  stem              TEXT NOT NULL,
  correct_answer    TEXT NOT NULL,
  answer_mechanism  TEXT,
  status            TEXT DEFAULT 'candidate',
  bloom_level       INTEGER CHECK (bloom_level BETWEEN 1 AND 6),
  generation_approach TEXT DEFAULT 'de_novo',
  source_chunk_uuids UUID[],
  qa_score_medical   NUMERIC(3,1),
  qa_score_coherence NUMERIC(3,1),
  qa_score_blueprint NUMERIC(3,1),
  -- ECD: Toulmin validity chain (display artifact — never traversed in graph)
  toulmin           JSONB,
  -- Cost tracking
  generation_cost_usd NUMERIC(8,4),
  neo4j_synced_at     TIMESTAMPTZ,
  neo4j_sync_status   TEXT DEFAULT 'pending',
  created_at          TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE TABLE distractors (
  uuid              UUID PRIMARY KEY,
  item_uuid         UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES assessment_items,
  option_letter     CHAR(1) NOT NULL CHECK (option_letter IN ('A','B','C','D','E')),
  text              TEXT NOT NULL,
  is_correct        BOOLEAN NOT NULL,
  evidence_rule     TEXT,           -- ECD: what mastery/misconception this option targets
  misconception_uuid TEXT           -- bridge to MisconceptionCategory Neo4j node
);
supabase/migrations/003_students_attempts.sqlFERPA: RLS scoped to institution + advisor
CREATE TABLE students (
  uuid            UUID PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES auth.users,
  institution_id  UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES institutions,
  enrollment_year INTEGER,
  cohort          TEXT,        -- 'M1-2025' etc.
  status          TEXT DEFAULT 'pending_approval'
);

-- FERPA RLS: students see only their own records
CREATE POLICY student_own_data ON attempts
  USING (student_uuid = auth.uid()
         OR /* advisors see assigned students */
         EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM advisor_assignments aa
                 WHERE aa.student_uuid = attempts.student_uuid
                 AND aa.advisor_uuid = auth.uid()));

CREATE TABLE attempts (
  uuid              UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  student_uuid      UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES students,
  institution_id    UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES institutions,
  item_uuid         UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES assessment_items,
  is_correct        BOOLEAN NOT NULL,
  selected_option   CHAR(1),
  selected_distractor_uuid UUID REFERENCES distractors,
  response_ms       INTEGER,
  exam_uuid         UUID,        -- NULL for practice
  mode              TEXT DEFAULT 'practice',
  created_at        TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);
CREATE INDEX attempts_student_idx ON attempts(student_uuid, created_at DESC);
CREATE INDEX attempts_item_idx ON attempts(item_uuid, created_at DESC);

CREATE TABLE mastery_snapshots (
  id              BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  student_uuid    UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES students,
  subconcept_uuid TEXT NOT NULL,  -- Neo4j bridge
  p_mastery       NUMERIC(5,4) NOT NULL,
  p_transit       NUMERIC(5,4),
  p_slip          NUMERIC(5,4),
  p_guess         NUMERIC(5,4),
  snapshot_date   DATE NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_DATE
);
-- Weekly snapshots enable mastery trajectory trending

CREATE TABLE audit_log (
  id              BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  institution_id  UUID NOT NULL,
  actor_uuid      UUID,
  actor_role      TEXT,
  action          TEXT NOT NULL,  -- 'item.approved' | 'exam.deployed' | etc.
  resource_type   TEXT,
  resource_uuid   TEXT,
  metadata        JSONB,
  ip_address      INET,
  created_at      TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);
CREATE INDEX audit_log_actor_idx ON audit_log(actor_uuid, created_at DESC);
-- Audit log has NO RLS — readable only by service_role (admin actions only)

// UUID uniqueness constraints — one per node type
// These also create supporting indexes automatically
CREATE CONSTRAINT subconcept_uuid_unique FOR (n:SubConcept) REQUIRE n.uuid IS UNIQUE;
CREATE CONSTRAINT content_chunk_uuid_unique FOR (n:ContentChunk) REQUIRE n.uuid IS UNIQUE;
CREATE CONSTRAINT assessment_item_uuid_unique FOR (n:AssessmentItem) REQUIRE n.uuid IS UNIQUE;
CREATE CONSTRAINT standard_term_cui_unique FOR (n:StandardTerm) REQUIRE n.cui IS UNIQUE;
CREATE CONSTRAINT task_shell_id_unique FOR (n:TaskShell) REQUIRE n.id IS UNIQUE;
CREATE CONSTRAINT misconception_id_unique FOR (n:MisconceptionCategory) REQUIRE n.id IS UNIQUE;
CREATE CONSTRAINT concept_cluster_community_unique FOR (n:ConceptCluster) REQUIRE n.community_id IS UNIQUE;

// Additional indexes for frequent lookups
CREATE INDEX subconcept_cui FOR (n:SubConcept) ON (n.cui);
CREATE INDEX subconcept_name FOR (n:SubConcept) ON (n.name);
CREATE INDEX subconcept_institution FOR (n:SubConcept) ON (n.institution_id);
CREATE INDEX content_chunk_lecture FOR (n:ContentChunk) ON (n.lecture_uuid);
CREATE INDEX assessment_item_status FOR (n:AssessmentItem) ON (n.status);
CREATE FULLTEXT INDEX chunk_fulltext FOR (n:ContentChunk) ON EACH [n.text];   // BM25
CREATE FULLTEXT INDEX subconcept_fulltext FOR (n:SubConcept) ON EACH [n.name];

Auth middleware — applied to every API route

// middleware.ts — Next.js middleware (runs on edge)
export async function middleware(request: NextRequest) {
  const supabase = createMiddlewareClient({ req: request, res: response });
  const { data: { session } } = await supabase.auth.getSession();

  if (!session && request.nextUrl.pathname.startsWith('/api/')) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });
  }

  // Role check: certain routes require specific roles
  const roleRequired = getRoleForRoute(request.nextUrl.pathname);
  if (roleRequired && session?.user.user_metadata.role !== roleRequired) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Forbidden' }, { status: 403 });
  }
}

// Route-level institution scoping — every Neo4j query includes institution_id
// This is defense-in-depth on top of Supabase RLS
async function neo4jQuery(cypher: string, params: object, institutionId: string) {
  return neo4jDriver.run(
    `${cypher} AND n.institution_id = $institutionId`,
    { ...params, institutionId }
  );
}

Pipeline status polling pattern (faculty UI)

// UI polls every 3 seconds during processing. Supabase realtime also pushes updates.
// Two-source status: poll as fallback, realtime as primary

// Supabase realtime subscription (in faculty upload component)
const channel = supabase
  .channel(`lecture:${lectureId}`)
  .on('postgres_changes', {
    event: 'UPDATE', schema: 'public', table: 'lectures',
    filter: `uuid=eq.${lectureId}`
  }, (payload) => setStatus(payload.new.status))
  .subscribe();

Pipeline 3 — Generation with ECD stages (core implementation)

P1 and P2 are fully specified in the Production Bible. P3 is reproduced here with the ECD integration as the most complex pipeline requiring implementation attention.

P3
journey/items.batch-generate
Timeout: 30min · Retries: 2 · Concurrency: 3 per faculty · ~$0.12/item · ECD-wired
Trigger: journey/generation.spec-confirmed 
export const generationPipeline = inngest.createFunction(
  { id: 'journey/items.batch-generate', ...inngestConfig['journey/items.batch-generate'] },
  { event: 'journey/generation.spec-confirmed' },
  async ({ event, step }) => {
    const { target_subconcept_uuids, spec } = event.data;

    // ── STEP 1: Load targets with gap-first ordering ────────────────────
    const targets = await step.run('load-targets', async () => {
      return neo4j.run(`
        UNWIND $uuids AS tid
        MATCH (sc:SubConcept {uuid: tid})
        OPTIONAL MATCH (sc)-[:HAS_COVERAGE]->(cr:CoverageRecord)
        OPTIONAL MATCH (sc)-[:MAPPED_TO]->(pv:ProficiencyVariable)
        RETURN sc.uuid, sc.name, sc.lod_brief_id, sc.clinical_consequence_score,
               sc.high_yield_score, sc.concept_family, pv.uuid AS pv_uuid,
               pv.mastery_definition, pv.evidence_threshold,
               cr.coverage_score AS coverage
        ORDER BY (sc.clinical_consequence_score * sc.high_yield_score
          * CASE WHEN cr IS NULL THEN 2.0 ELSE 1.0 END) DESC
      `, { uuids: target_subconcept_uuids });
    });

    // ── STEPS ECD 1-3: Identify PV → Define Evidence Rules → Select TaskShell
    const ecd_specs = await step.run('ecd-stages-1-3', async () => {
      return Promise.all(targets.map(async (target, idx) => {
        // ECD Stage 2: Define evidence rules (Haiku — cheap)
        const evidenceRules = await claude.generate({
          model: 'claude-haiku-4-5-20251001',
          prompt: `For ProficiencyVariable: "${target.mastery_definition}" at Bloom ${spec.bloom_levels[idx] || spec.bloom_default}.
Define evidence rules for a 5-option NBME item:
Return JSON: { correct_evidence: string, distractor_misconceptions: string[4] }`,
          max_tokens: 200
        });
        // ECD Stage 3: Select TaskShell by bloom_range + concept_family
        const shell = await neo4j.run(`
          MATCH (ts:TaskShell)
          WHERE $bloom >= ts.bloom_range[0] AND $bloom <= ts.bloom_range[1]
            AND ts.concept_family = $family
          RETURN ts ORDER BY ts.avg_quality_score DESC LIMIT 1
        `, { bloom: spec.bloom_default, family: target.concept_family });
        return { target, evidenceRules: evidenceRules.parsed, shell: shell[0] };
      }));
    });

    // ── STEP 2: HyDE + Parallel 4-source context assembly ───────────────
    const contexts = await step.run('hyde-context-assembly', async () => {
      return Promise.all(ecd_specs.map(async ({ target }) => {
        // HyDE: generate hypothetical vignette for retrieval
        const hyde = await claude.generate({
          model: 'claude-haiku-4-5-20251001',
          prompt: `Write a 2-sentence USMLE clinical vignette about "${target.name}". Clinical only.`,
          max_tokens: 100
        });
        const hydeEmb = await embed(hyde.text, 'MedCPT');
        // LOD brief: Supabase key-value read (<5ms) — G05 fix
        const lodBriefRow = await supabase.from('subconcept_lod_briefs')
          .select('lod_brief').eq('subconcept_uuid', target.uuid).single();

        // Parallel 4-source fan-out
        const [local, structured, global] = await Promise.all([
          hybridRRF({ denseEmbedding: hydeEmb, bm25Query: target.name, k: 60, topK: 5 }),
          neo4j.run(`MATCH (sc:SubConcept {uuid:$id})-[:ALIGNS_TO]->(sub:USMLE_Subtopic)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(top)-[:PART_OF]->(sys)
            OPTIONAL MATCH (sc)<-[:COVERS_TOPIC]-(slo:SLO) RETURN sys.name, top.name, sub.name, slo.text LIMIT 5`, {id: target.uuid}),
          neo4j.run(`MATCH (sc:SubConcept {uuid:$id})-[:BELONGS_TO_CLUSTER]->(cc:ConceptCluster) RETURN cc.summary`, {id: target.uuid})
        ]);

        return packTokenBudget({
          local,                               // 3,000 tokens
          structured,                          // 800 tokens
          lod_brief: lodBriefRow.data?.lod_brief, // 500 tokens — always included (D10)
          global,                              // 400 tokens (null if ConceptCluster N/A)
          budget: 6000
        });
      }));
    });

    // ── STEP 3: Core generation — SONNET 4 (D05 canonical) ──────────────
    const cores = await step.run('generate-core', async () => {
      return Promise.all(ecd_specs.map(({ target, shell, evidenceRules }, i) =>
        claude.generate({
          model: 'claude-sonnet-4-20250514',   // CANONICAL — D05
          system: NBME_SYSTEM_PROMPT,
          prompt: buildCorePrompt(target, contexts[i], shell, evidenceRules, spec),
          max_tokens: 600,
          response_format: { type: 'json_schema', schema: ITEM_CORE_SCHEMA }
        })
      ));
    });

    // ── STEP 4: Critique gate — Sonnet-as-critic ─────────────────────────
    const critiqued = await step.run('critique-gate', async () =>
      Promise.all(cores.map(async (core, i) => {
        let item = core, retries = 0;
        while (retries < 2) {
          const crit = await claude.generate({ model: 'claude-sonnet-4-20250514',
            prompt: buildCritiquePrompt(item, contexts[i], ecd_specs[i].evidenceRules), max_tokens: 200 });
          if (crit.pass || crit.severity === 'minor') break;
          item = await regenerateWithFeedback(ecd_specs[i].target, contexts[i], spec, crit.issues); retries++;
        }
        return { item, passed: retries < 2 };
      }))
    );

    // ── STEP 5: Distractors — Haiku + MisconceptionCategory graph ────────
    const distractors = await step.run('generate-distractors', async () =>
      Promise.all(critiqued.map(async ({item}, i) => {
        const misconceptions = await neo4j.run(`
          MATCH (sc:SubConcept {uuid:$uuid})-[:ALIGNS_TO]->(sub:USMLE_Subtopic)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(top)-[:PART_OF]->(sys)
          MATCH (mc:MisconceptionCategory) WHERE sys.name IN mc.usmle_systems
          RETURN mc.name, mc.description, mc.example_distractor_pattern
          ORDER BY mc.empirical_frequency DESC LIMIT 4
        `, { uuid: ecd_specs[i].target.uuid });
        return claude.generate({ model: 'claude-haiku-4-5-20251001',
          prompt: buildDistractorPrompt(item, misconceptions, ecd_specs[i].evidenceRules), max_tokens: 300 });
      }))
    );

    // ── STEP 6: Rationale + QA (Haiku) + Toulmin JSONB ───────────────────
    const qa_results = await step.run('rationale-qa-toulmin', async () =>
      Promise.all(critiqued.map(async ({item}, i) => {
        const [rationale, qa] = await Promise.all([
          claude.generate({ model: 'claude-haiku-4-5-20251001',
            prompt: buildRationalePrompt(item, contexts[i]), max_tokens: 400 }),
          claude.generate({ model: 'claude-haiku-4-5-20251001',
            prompt: buildQAPrompt(item, distractors[i], contexts[i]), max_tokens: 150 })
        ]);
        // Toulmin chain stored as JSONB in Supabase assessment_items.toulmin
        // NEVER traversed in Neo4j — display artifact only
        const toulmin = buildToulmin(item, ecd_specs[i], contexts[i]);
        return { rationale, qa, toulmin };
      }))
    );

    // ── STEP 7: Provenance write to Neo4j + Supabase ─────────────────────
    await step.run('provenance-write', async () => {
      for (const [i, core] of critiqued.entries()) {
        const itemUuid = deterministicUuid(`item:${event.data.batch_id}:${i}`);
        // Supabase write (primary source of truth for content)
        await supabase.from('assessment_items').upsert({
          uuid: itemUuid, stem: core.item.stem, correct_answer: core.item.correct_answer,
          toulmin: qa_results[i].toulmin, qa_score_medical: qa_results[i].qa.medical,
          generation_cost_usd: computeCost(core, distractors[i], qa_results[i])
        });
        // Neo4j write (skinny node + typed edges)
        await neo4j.run(`
          MERGE (i:AssessmentItem {uuid:$uuid})
            ON CREATE SET i.status='candidate', i.established_at=datetime()
          WITH i
          MATCH (ts:TaskShell {id:$shellId}), (pv:ProficiencyVariable {uuid:$pvUuid}),
                (chunk:ContentChunk {uuid:$chunkUuid})
          MERGE (i)-[:INSTANTIATES]->(ts)
          MERGE (i)-[:CLAIMS_ABOUT]->(pv)
          MERGE (i)-[:SOURCED_FROM {established_at:datetime()}]->(chunk)
        `, { uuid: itemUuid, shellId: ecd_specs[i].shell.id, pvUuid: ecd_specs[i].target.pv_uuid, chunkUuid: core.item.source_chunk_uuids[0] });
      }
    });

    // ── STEP 8: Faculty approval gate ────────────────────────────────────
    const reviewEvent = await step.waitForEvent('journey/items.batch-reviewed', {
      match: 'data.batch_id', timeout: '30d'
    });
    const decisions = reviewEvent?.data.decisions ?? autoApproveHighQuality(qa_results);

    // ── STEP 9: Post-approval activation ────────────────────────────────
    await step.run('post-approval', async () => {
      for (const [uuid, decision] of Object.entries(decisions)) {
        if (decision !== 'approved') continue;
        await neo4j.run(`
          MATCH (i:AssessmentItem {uuid:$uuid})-[:CLAIMS_ABOUT]->(pv:ProficiencyVariable)
                <-[:MAPPED_TO]-(sc:SubConcept)
          SET i.status = 'approved'
          MERGE (sc)-[:HAS_COVERAGE]->(cr:CoverageRecord)
            ON CREATE SET cr.assessment_count = 1, cr.coverage_score = 0.33
            ON MATCH SET
              cr.assessment_count = cr.assessment_count + 1,
              cr.coverage_score = toFloat(min(cr.assessment_count + 1, 3)) / 3.0
          -- BKT_Parameters initialized with AI-estimated difficulty
          MERGE (bkt:BKT_Parameters)-[:FOR_ITEM]->(i) ON CREATE SET bkt.calibration_phase='ai_estimated'
        `, { uuid });
      }
      await inngest.send({ name: 'journey/items.approved',
        data: { item_uuids: Object.keys(decisions).filter(k => decisions[k] === 'approved'), subconcept_uuids: ecd_specs.map(s => s.target.uuid) }
      });
    });
  }
);

BKT mastery update function (real-time, high-volume)

// journey/mastery.update — triggered on every attempt.recorded
// Hybrid BKT-IRT: Pavlik, Cen & Koedinger (2009)

export const masteryUpdate = inngest.createFunction(
  { id: 'journey/mastery.update', concurrency: { limit: 100 }, retries: 5, timeoutMs: 30000 },
  { event: 'journey/attempt.recorded' },
  async ({ event }) => {
    const { student_uuid, item_uuid, is_correct, selected_distractor_uuid } = event.data;

    await step.run('update-bkt', async () => {
      const { bkt, irt, subconcept_uuid } = await loadItemAndParams(item_uuid, student_uuid);
      // Hybrid BKT-IRT: modulate slip/guess by IRT difficulty (D05 fix upstream)
      const p_slip_item = bkt.p_slip + (1 - bkt.p_slip) * sigmoid(irt.difficulty - THETA_THRESHOLD);
      const p_guess_item = bkt.p_guess + (1 - bkt.p_guess) * sigmoid(THETA_THRESHOLD - irt.difficulty);
      const evidence_weight = Math.min(irt.discrimination / AVG_DISCRIMINATION, 2.0);
      const p_mastered = is_correct
        ? (bkt.p_mastery * (1 - p_slip_item)) / (bkt.p_mastery * (1 - p_slip_item) + (1 - bkt.p_mastery) * p_guess_item)
        : (bkt.p_mastery * p_slip_item) / (bkt.p_mastery * p_slip_item + (1 - bkt.p_mastery) * (1 - p_guess_item));
      const new_p_mastery = p_mastered + evidence_weight * (p_mastered - bkt.p_mastery) + bkt.p_transit;

      // Update Neo4j StudentMastery node
      await neo4j.run(`
        MATCH (s:Student {uuid:$student})-[:HAS_MASTERY]->(sm:StudentMastery)-[:FOR_CONCEPT]->(sc:SubConcept {uuid:$sc})
        SET sm.p_mastery = $mastery, sm.last_updated = datetime()
      `, { student: student_uuid, sc: subconcept_uuid, mastery: Math.min(Math.max(new_p_mastery, 0), 1) });

      // Misconception feedback: update empirical_frequency on selected distractor's target
      if (!is_correct && selected_distractor_uuid) {
        await neo4j.run(`
          MATCH (d:Distractor {uuid:$did})-[:TARGETS_MISCONCEPTION]->(mc:MisconceptionCategory)
          SET mc.empirical_frequency = mc.empirical_frequency + 1
        `, { did: selected_distractor_uuid });
      }
    });

    await step.sendEvent({ name: 'journey/mastery.updated', data: { student_uuid, subconcept_uuid, p_mastery: new_p_mastery, delta: new_p_mastery - bkt.p_mastery } });
  }
);
V-b / Agentic RAG Implementation & Neo4j GDS

RetrieverRouter · RRF k=60 · GDS PageRank & Louvain

Agentic RAG — RetrieverRouter pattern (Bratanic & Hane Ch. 4)

// apps/ai/src/rag/retriever-router.ts
// RetrieverRouter: classifies query → routes to correct specialist agent
// T2: LOCAL + STRUCTURED only. GLOBAL unlocks at T4 (ConceptCluster seeded).

const QUERY_TYPES = [
  { type: 'local',      description: 'Specific facts from lecture content' },
  { type: 'structured', description: 'Framework alignments, coverage gaps, SLO chains' },
  { type: 'global',     description: 'Thematic overview, curriculum patterns (T4+ only)' },
  { type: 'hybrid',     description: 'Combines content with structural context' },
] as const;

export async function retrieverRouter(query: string, ctx: RequestContext) {
  // Step 1: Route classification (Haiku — cheap)
  const route = await claude.generate({
    model: 'claude-haiku-4-5-20251001',
    prompt: `Classify this query into one of: local, structured, global, hybrid.
Query: "${query}"
Context: Faculty query about curriculum at ${ctx.institution}.
Return JSON: { type: string, reasoning: string }`,
    max_tokens: 60
  });

  // Step 2: Route to specialist retriever
  const isGlobalEnabled = process.env.ENABLE_CONCEPT_CLUSTER_GLOBAL === 'true';

  switch (route.type) {
    case 'local':
      return localRetriever(query, ctx);       // HyDE + hybrid RRF (dense + BM25)
    case 'structured':
      return structuredRetriever(query, ctx);   // Text2Cypher → Neo4j traversal
    case 'global':
      return isGlobalEnabled
        ? globalRetriever(query, ctx)            // ConceptCluster embeddings (T4+)
        : structuredRetriever(query, ctx);       // G11 fallback until T4
    case 'hybrid':
      const [local, structured] = await Promise.all([
        localRetriever(query, ctx),
        structuredRetriever(query, ctx)
      ]);
      return mergeContexts(local, structured);
  }
}

// Local retriever: HyDE → Hybrid RRF k=60 (BM25 + dense) → Parent Doc Retriever
async function localRetriever(query: string, ctx: RequestContext) {
  // HyDE: generate hypothetical answer for retrieval bait
  const hyde = await claude.generate({
    model: 'claude-haiku-4-5-20251001',
    prompt: `Write a 2-sentence answer to: "${query}" in a medical curriculum context.`,
    max_tokens: 80
  });
  const hydeEmb = await embed(hyde.text, 'MedCPT');

  // Hybrid RRF k=60: merge BM25 (Neo4j fulltext) + dense cosine (pgvector)
  const [bm25Results, denseResults] = await Promise.all([
    neo4j.run(`
      CALL db.index.fulltext.queryNodes('chunk_fulltext', $query, {limit: 30})
      YIELD node, score
      WHERE node.institution_id = $instId
      RETURN node.uuid, score
    `, { query, instId: ctx.institution_id }),
    supabase.rpc('match_chunks_biomedical', {
      query_embedding: hydeEmb, match_count: 30, institution_id: ctx.institution_id
    })
  ]);

  // RRF fusion: score = Σ 1/(k + rank_i) where k=60
  const rrf = reciprocalRankFusion(bm25Results, denseResults, { k: 60, topK: 5 });

  // Parent Document Retriever: retrieve at chunk, return section (HAS_CHUNK ← LectureSection)
  const withParent = await neo4j.run(`
    UNWIND $chunkUuids AS cid
    MATCH (chunk:ContentChunk {uuid: cid})<-[:HAS_CHUNK]-(sec:LectureSection)<-[:HAS_SECTION]-(lec:Lecture)
    RETURN chunk.text AS chunk_text, sec.body_text AS section_context, lec.title
  `, { chunkUuids: rrf.map(r => r.uuid) });

  return withParent;
}

// Structured retriever: Text2Cypher with medical few-shot examples
async function structuredRetriever(query: string, ctx: RequestContext) {
  // Retrieve few-shot examples from Supabase few_shot_examples table
  const fewShots = await supabase.from('few_shot_examples').select('natural_language, cypher').limit(5);

  // Text2Cypher: Sonnet generates Cypher from NL + schema + examples
  const cypherQuery = await claude.generate({
    model: 'claude-sonnet-4-20250514',
    system: buildText2CypherPrompt(NEO4J_SCHEMA_SUMMARY, fewShots.data),
    prompt: `Convert to Cypher. Always filter: institution_id = "${ctx.institution_id}". Query: "${query}"`,
    max_tokens: 400
  });
  return neo4j.run(cypherQuery.text, { institution_id: ctx.institution_id });
}

// AnswerCritic: validates response quality — max 2 retry iterations
export async function withAnswerCritic(query: string, context: RetrievedContext) {
  let answer = await generateAnswer(query, context);
  for (let i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
    const critique = await claude.generate({
      model: 'claude-sonnet-4-20250514',
      prompt: `Does this answer faithfully use the provided context?
Query: ${query} | Answer: ${answer.text} | Context: ${context.text}
Return JSON: { faithful: boolean, issues: string[] }`,
      max_tokens: 150
    });
    if (critique.faithful) break;
    answer = await generateAnswer(query, context, critique.issues);
  }
  return answer;
}

RRF k=60 implementation

// lib/retrieval/rrf.ts — Reciprocal Rank Fusion (Cormack, Clarke & Buettcher, SIGIR 2009)
// k=60 smoothing parameter per original paper recommendation for IR fusion tasks

export function reciprocalRankFusion(
  rankedLists: RankedResult[][],
  options: { k?: number; topK?: number } = {}
): RankedResult[] {
  const { k = 60, topK = 5 } = options;  // k=60 is canonical (D10: always used)
  const scores = new Map<string, number>();

  for (const list of rankedLists) {
    list.forEach((result, rank) => {
      const current = scores.get(result.uuid) || 0;
      scores.set(result.uuid, current + 1 / (k + rank + 1));  // 1/(k + rank)
    });
  }
  return Array.from(scores.entries())
    .sort(([,a],[,b]) => b - a)
    .slice(0, topK)
    .map(([uuid, score]) => ({ uuid, rrf_score: score }));
}

Neo4j GDS calls — PageRank & Louvain (T4+ features)

// scripts/gds/compute-pagerank.ts — run weekly after T4 (via Inngest)
// PageRank → SubConcept.pagerank_score → clinical_consequence_score ordering

async function computePageRank(institutionId: string) {
  // Project graph: SubConcept nodes + TEACHES/ALIGNS_TO/GROUNDED_IN edges
  await neo4j.run(`
    CALL gds.graph.project.cypher(
      'subconcept-graph',
      'MATCH (n:SubConcept {institution_id: $instId}) RETURN id(n) AS id',
      'MATCH (a:SubConcept)-[r:TEACHES|ALIGNS_TO|GROUNDED_IN]-(b:SubConcept)
       WHERE a.institution_id = $instId RETURN id(a) AS source, id(b) AS target',
      { parameters: { instId: institutionId } }
    )
  `);

  // Run PageRank, write back to node property
  await neo4j.run(`
    CALL gds.pageRank.write('subconcept-graph', {
      writeProperty: 'pagerank_score',
      dampingFactor: 0.85,
      maxIterations: 20
    })
    YIELD nodePropertiesWritten, ranIterations
  `);
  // clinical_consequence_score = pagerank_score × usmle_blueprint_weight × disease_mortality_factor
  await neo4j.run(`
    MATCH (sc:SubConcept {institution_id: $instId})-[:ALIGNS_TO]->(sub:USMLE_Subtopic)
    SET sc.clinical_consequence_score =
      sc.pagerank_score * sub.nbme_frequency * coalesce(sc.disease_mortality_factor, 0.5)
  `, { instId: institutionId });
  await neo4j.run(`CALL gds.graph.drop('subconcept-graph')`);
}

// scripts/gds/compute-louvain.ts — run once at T4 to create ConceptCluster nodes
// Louvain: Blondel et al. (2008) community detection
async function computeLouvain(institutionId: string) {
  await neo4j.run(`
    CALL gds.graph.project('subconcept-louvain',
      { SubConcept: { label: 'SubConcept', properties: ['pagerank_score'] } },
      { TEACHES: { orientation: 'UNDIRECTED' }, EXPLAINS_SAME_CONCEPT: { orientation: 'UNDIRECTED' } }
    )
  `);
  await neo4j.run(`
    CALL gds.louvain.write('subconcept-louvain', { writeProperty: 'community_id' })
    YIELD communityCount, modularity
  `);
  // Create ConceptCluster nodes from communities with ≥5 SubConcepts
  // LLM-generate cluster summary using community members' names
  await neo4j.run(`
    MATCH (sc:SubConcept {institution_id: $instId})
    WITH sc.community_id AS cid, collect(sc) AS members
    WHERE size(members) >= 5
    MERGE (cc:ConceptCluster {community_id: cid})
      ON CREATE SET cc.member_count = size(members)
    WITH cc, members
    UNWIND members AS sc
    MERGE (sc)-[:BELONGS_TO_CLUSTER]->(cc)
  `, { instId: institutionId });
  // After creation: generate LLM summaries for each cluster (background job)
  await inngest.send({ name: 'journey/gnn.community-detect', data: { institution_id: institutionId } });
  await neo4j.run(`CALL gds.graph.drop('subconcept-louvain')`);
}

// components/pipeline/LectureStatus.tsx
// Real-time status display — Supabase realtime + fallback polling
export function LectureStatus({ lectureId }: { lectureId: string }) {
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<string>('pending');

  useEffect(() => {
    // Primary: Supabase realtime push
    const channel = supabase
      .channel(`lecture:${lectureId}`)
      .on('postgres_changes', { event: 'UPDATE', table: 'lectures', filter: `uuid=eq.${lectureId}` },
        (payload) => setStatus(payload.new.status))
      .subscribe();
    // Fallback: poll every 5 seconds
    const interval = setInterval(() =>
      fetch(`/api/lectures/${lectureId}/status`).then(r => r.json()).then(d => setStatus(d.status)),
    5000);
    return () => { supabase.removeChannel(channel); clearInterval(interval); };
  }, [lectureId]);

  return <StatusBar label={STATUS_LABELS[status]} status={status} />;
}
// components/items/WhyWrong.tsx
// "Why Wrong?" explanation — Haiku with evidence_rule context
export function WhyWrong({ distractorUuid, itemUuid }: Props) {
  const [explanation, setExplanation] = useState<string|null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

  const explain = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    // Server-side Haiku call — evidence_rule + MisconceptionCategory.description
    const res = await fetch(`/api/items/${itemUuid}/why-wrong`, {
      method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ distractor_uuid: distractorUuid })
    });
    const data = await res.json();
    setExplanation(data.explanation);
    setLoading(false);
  };

  return (
    <div>
      <Button onClick={explain}>Why was this wrong?</Button>
      {explanation && <MisconceptionExplanation text={explanation} />}
    </div>
  );
}

VII / Security & Compliance

FERPA · RLS · Audit logging · Secrets management

FERPA Enforcement
PostgreSQL RLS — architecturally enforced

Row-Level Security on every table with student data. institution_id = auth.jwt()->>'institution_id' on all tables. Students see only their own attempts. Advisors see only assigned students. Aggregate stats: min cell size = 5. Cannot be bypassed even by application bugs — enforced at the DB level.

Audit Logging
Every consequential action logged

audit_log table with actor_uuid, role, action, resource_type, resource_uuid, ip_address, timestamp. Actions logged: item.approved, item.rejected, exam.deployed, student.approved, faculty.invited, syllabus.uploaded. Log readable only by service_role — not by faculty or admin via RLS. Retained 7 years.

Secrets Management
Never in browser, never in git

All API keys (Anthropic, UMLS, Neo4j, OpenAI) in Vercel environment variables. NEXT_PUBLIC_* prefix only for genuinely public values (Supabase URL + anon key). Neo4j Bolt URI + credentials in server-only env vars. Inngest signing key server-only. Faculty never has access to API keys.

-- ── C01: Exam answer auto-save ─────────────────────────────────────────────
CREATE TABLE session_answers (
  session_id     UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES sessions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  item_order     INT NOT NULL,
  selected_index INT,                   -- null = skipped
  flagged        BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE,  -- student flagged for review
  answered_at    TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at     TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now(),
  PRIMARY KEY (session_id, item_order)
);
-- Upsert pattern: INSERT ... ON CONFLICT (session_id, item_order) DO UPDATE SET ...

-- ── H05: Per-student scramble map ──────────────────────────────────────────
CREATE TABLE session_items (
  session_id      UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES sessions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  display_order   INT NOT NULL,
  item_id         UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES assessment_items(id),
  item_version    INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,  -- version used at exam time
  option_order    INT[] NOT NULL,            -- e.g. [3,0,1,4,2] = shuffled indices
  correct_option_pos INT NOT NULL,           -- correct answer's position in option_order
  PRIMARY KEY (session_id, display_order),
  UNIQUE (session_id, item_id)
);

-- ── H02: Item version history ───────────────────────────────────────────────
CREATE TABLE item_versions (
  id              UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  item_id         UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES assessment_items(id),
  version_number  INT NOT NULL,
  stem            TEXT NOT NULL,
  correct_answer  TEXT NOT NULL,
  distractors     JSONB NOT NULL,          -- [{text, evidence_rule, misconception_code}]
  edited_by       UUID REFERENCES faculty_profiles(id),
  edit_reason     TEXT,
  edited_at       TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now(),
  UNIQUE (item_id, version_number)
);
-- Trigger: before UPDATE on assessment_items where status='approved', insert into item_versions
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION version_item_on_edit() RETURNS TRIGGER AS $$
BEGIN
  IF OLD.status = 'approved' AND (OLD.stem <> NEW.stem OR OLD.correct_answer <> NEW.correct_answer) THEN
    INSERT INTO item_versions (item_id, version_number, stem, correct_answer, distractors, edited_by)
    SELECT OLD.id,
      coalesce((SELECT MAX(version_number) FROM item_versions WHERE item_id = OLD.id), 0) + 1,
      OLD.stem, OLD.correct_answer,
      (SELECT jsonb_agg(row_to_json(d)) FROM distractors d WHERE d.assessment_item_id = OLD.id),
      NEW.updated_by;
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END; $$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;
CREATE TRIGGER item_version_trigger
  BEFORE UPDATE ON assessment_items
  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION version_item_on_edit();

Neo4j tenant wrapper — mandatory pattern

// lib/neo4j/client.ts — ONLY import this, never import neo4j-driver directly
import { driver } from './driver';

interface QueryContext { institution_id: string; actor_id?: string }

export async function neo4jQuery(
  cypher: string,
  params: Record<string, unknown>,
  ctx: QueryContext,
  fallback?: unknown
) {
  // Validate institution_id is in params (dev-time enforcement)
  if (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development' && !cypher.includes('institution_id')) {
    // Some ref-node queries legitimately don't need institution scoping
    if (!cypher.includes(':Reference') && !cypher.includes(':USMLE') && !cypher.includes(':LCME')) {
      console.warn(`[neo4j] Missing institution_id in: ${cypher.slice(0,80)}`);
    }
  }
  try {
    const result = await driver.executeQuery(cypher, { ...params, institution_id: ctx.institution_id });
    return result.records;
  } catch (err) {
    if (isConnectionError(err) && fallback !== undefined) {
      // Graceful degradation: return fallback, log, don't throw
      logger.warn('Neo4j unavailable — returning fallback', { cypher: cypher.slice(0,60) });
      return fallback;
    }
    throw err;
  }
}

JSON repair and per-item failure isolation

// lib/llm/safe-parse.ts — use everywhere a Claude response is parsed
import { jsonrepair } from 'jsonrepair';

export function safeJsonParse<T>(text: string): { data: T | null; repaired: boolean } {
  // Strip common Claude markdown wrappers
  const clean = text.replace(/```json\n?|\n?```/g, '').trim();
  try {
    return { data: JSON.parse(clean), repaired: false };
  } catch {
    try {
      return { data: JSON.parse(jsonrepair(clean)), repaired: true };
    } catch {
      logger.warn('JSON parse failed after repair', { text: clean.slice(0,200) });
      return { data: null, repaired: false };
    }
  }
}

// P3 batch generation: Promise.allSettled for per-item isolation
const results = await Promise.allSettled(targets.map(target => generateItem(target, context)));
const succeeded = results.filter(r => r.status === 'fulfilled').map(r => r.value);
const failed    = results.filter(r => r.status === 'rejected');
if (failed.length / results.length > 0.2) {
  await inngest.send({ name: 'journey/pipeline.failed', data: { pipeline: 'p3', failure_rate: failed.length / results.length } });
}

Context assembly with prompt injection defense and XML delimiters

// lib/generation/context-assembly.ts
function sanitizeForContext(text: string): string {
  return text
    .replace(/system\s*:/gi, '[system_ref]')
    .replace(/ignore\s+(all\s+)?(previous|prior|above)\s+instructions?/gi, '[redacted]')
    .replace(/disregard\s+.{0,30}instructions?/gi, '[redacted]')
    .replace(/jailbreak|DAN mode|developer mode/gi, '[redacted]');
}

export function buildContextBlock(localChunks: string[], lodBrief: string, structured: string): string {
  return `<lecture_content>
${sanitizeForContext(localChunks.join('\n\n'))}
</lecture_content>

<lod_brief>
${sanitizeForContext(lodBrief)}
</lod_brief>

<usmle_alignment>
${sanitizeForContext(structured)}
</usmle_alignment>`;
}
// All generation prompts begin: "Using ONLY the information in <lecture_content>, <lod_brief>, and <usmle_alignment>..."

Exam session creation with scramble + accommodation

// api/exams/[id]/start/route.ts — creates exam session with scrambled items
export async function POST(req: Request, { params }: { params: { id: string } }) {
  const { studentId } = await getAuthContext(req);
  const exam = await supabase.from('exams').select('*').eq('id', params.id).single();

  // Validate exam window
  const now = new Date();
  if (exam.available_from && now < new Date(exam.available_from)) return error('Exam not yet available', 403);
  if (exam.available_until && now > new Date(exam.available_until)) return error('Exam window has closed', 410);

  // Load accommodation time multiplier
  const accommodation = await supabase.from('student_accommodations')
    .select('time_multiplier').eq('student_id', studentId).eq('exam_id', params.id).maybeSingle();
  const timeMultiplier = accommodation?.time_multiplier ?? 1.0;

  // Create session + scramble items deterministically
  const sessionId = generateUUID();
  const seed = `${studentId}-${params.id}`;                    // deterministic seed
  const examItems = await supabase.from('exam_items').select('*').eq('exam_id', params.id).order('item_order');
  const scrambledItems = seededShuffle(examItems.data, seed);
  const sessionItems = scrambledItems.map((item, displayOrder) => ({
    session_id: sessionId, display_order: displayOrder, item_id: item.item_id,
    item_version: item.current_version,
    option_order: seededShuffle([0,1,2,3,4], `${seed}-${item.item_id}`),
    correct_option_pos: /* recalculated from shuffle */ 0
  }));

  await supabase.from('session_items').insert(sessionItems);
  await supabase.from('sessions').insert({
    id: sessionId, student_id: studentId, session_type: 'timed_exam', exam_id: params.id,
    total_items: examItems.data.length,
    time_limit_mins: Math.round(exam.time_limit_mins * timeMultiplier)
  });
  return { sessionId, timeLimit: exam.time_limit_mins * timeMultiplier };
}

LOD brief expiry check in context assembly

// In P3 hyde-context-assembly step — check brief age before using
const lodRow = await supabase
  .from('subconcept_lod_briefs')
  .select('lod_brief, expires_at, umls_release')
  .eq('subconcept_uuid', target.uuid)
  .single();

let lodBrief = lodRow.data?.lod_brief;

if (!lodBrief || new Date(lodRow.data.expires_at) < new Date()) {
  // Brief expired — fall back to live UMLS lookup for context
  // (slower but clinically current)
  const liveUmls = await umlsApi.getConcept(target.cui);
  lodBrief = liveUmls.definition ?? `${target.name}: UMLS lookup fallback (brief expired)`;
  // Queue re-enrichment but don't block generation
  await inngest.send({ name: 'journey/subconcept.confirmed', data: { subConceptId: target.uuid } });
}

SAME_AS cycle prevention

// In P1 Step 03 (extract-entities) — before creating SAME_AS edges
async function createSameAsIfSafe(aUuid: string, bUuid: string, confidence: number) {
  // Check for cycle: can B already reach A via SAME_AS?
  const [cycleCheck] = await neo4jQuery(`
    MATCH (b {uuid: $b})
    WHERE EXISTS {
      MATCH (b)-[:SAME_AS*1..6]->(a {uuid: $a})
    }
    RETURN count(*) AS would_cycle
  `, { a: aUuid, b: bUuid }, ctx);

  if (cycleCheck.get('would_cycle').toNumber() > 0) {
    await supabase.from('entity_resolution_conflicts').insert({
      source_uuid: aUuid, target_uuid: bUuid, conflict_type: 'cycle_prevention'
    });
    return;  // skip — human reviews the conflict log quarterly
  }

  // Direction convention: always lower CUI string → higher CUI string
  const [from, to] = aUuid < bUuid ? [aUuid, bUuid] : [bUuid, aUuid];
  await neo4jQuery(`
    MERGE (a {uuid: $from})-[:SAME_AS {confidence: $conf, method: 'cui_match', created_at: datetime()}]->(b {uuid: $to})
  `, { from, to, conf: confidence }, ctx);
}
